rules.coverage_text: Rental dwelling units, other than units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four units.
rules.effective_expression: first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment

exemptions.description: Dwelling unit in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
exemptions.quote: other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units

rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 first violation; $5,000 second within five years; $10,000 for two or more others within seven years.
rules.quote: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
relations_hint: Nothing herein contained shall bar, exclude or otherwise affect any right or action which may exist independently of any right or action created herein
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not require applications with criminal record inquiries or ask about criminal record before a conditional offer, with narrow exceptions (methamphetamine manufacture in federally assisted housing; lifetime sex offender registration).
rules.title: Ban the box: no criminal record inquiry before conditional offer

rules.coverage_text: Rental dwelling units, other than units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four units.

exemptions.description: Owner-occupied premises of not more than four units

rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 first violation; $5,000 second within five years; $10,000 for two or more others within seven years.
rules.quote: A housing provider shall not, either before or after the issuance of a conditional offer, evaluate an applicant based on any of the following types of criminal records:
rules.requirement: Providers may not evaluate arrests without conviction, expunged, pardoned, vacated, juvenile or sealed records; after a conditional offer only specified convictions within set lookback periods may be considered, with individualized assessment.
rules.title: Limits on criminal records considered
